name: codex-orchestration
description: Two-stage classification and single-agent execution with previous-task continuity.

interface.longDescription: Activate Codex Orchestration with Turn Orchestration on, Use Orchestration, or Use Orchestration for this chat. Version 0.13.0 uses two stages only: GPT-5.6 Terra / Extra High classifies the request, then one Luna / Max, Terra / Max, or Sol / High agent owns the work. There are no supervisors, implementation checkpoints, or review loops. The selected agent interprets scope, performs the work, verifies it, completes any explicitly authorized release, and writes a balanced final response with substantive current-state and recommendation sections plus a legitimate next step when one exists. For experience-dependent outcomes, root performs one terminal visual check against cited ground truth and finishes the task with a pass, fail, or blocked report. Previous-task continuity, quiet startup, premise-mismatch checks, exact task bundles, and the compact route footer remain.
defaultPrompt: Tell me “Turn Orchestration on” for same-chat read-only, artifact, tweak, and build routing.
